description: Find and replace text inside one field of a post (for example its content), without sending the whole content again. Supports regular expressions with regex set to true and modifiers in flags.

field.description: Field to modify: post_content, post_excerpt, or post_title.

flags.description: Optional PCRE modifier letters applied in regex mode, e.g. "i" (case-insensitive), "s" (dotall), "m" (multiline). Allowed: i, m, s, x, u, A, D, S, U, X, J.

regex.description: Treat search as a regex pattern (default: false).

replace.description: Replacement text. In regex mode, backreferences like $1 / \1 are supported.

search.description: Text to search for, or (with regex=true) a bare PCRE pattern without delimiters, e.g. <!-- /wp:paragraph -->\s*$

name: wp_alter_post
title: Edit post text
